messages:
Sam (CEO): quick thread from today's all-hands Q&A 11111  please drop concise reasons for wins/losses + one action each so we can prioritize. trying to keep this tight.
Priya (Product): format request: 1-sentence why we won, 1-sentence why we lost (if applicable), and a single product ask.
Diego (Sales): Win: retail telemetry company picked Redwood Dedicated because of guaranteed tail latency SLO and cost predictability for peak traffic.
Diego (Sales): Loss: enterprise payments team pulled RFQ because our private deployment ETA didn't meet their audit timeline; also legal wanted a canned DPA example.
Hannah (Customer Success): From onboarding: customers consistently request an "initial network checklist" and sample VPC peering config. That's come up in 3 deals this quarter.
Owen (Eng): Root cause for the payments deal: we don't have a vetted cloud-region build of Private in their EMEA region yet, and our long-context kernels produced occasional 99th-pct spikes.
Marta (Data): Quality note: one customer used many chained system prompts which caused attention fragmentation; our quantized profile dropped BLEU-like score ~7% on their eval set.
Priya (Product): Suggested asks: (A) Private region MVP in EMEA (B) onboarding starter kit + terraform module (C) Dedicated procurement one-pager for security reviewers.
Diego (Sales): Sales collateral ask: simple table: "Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private" + procurement checklist (SAML, KMS, audit logs, SLA). I can draft.
Hannah (Customer Success): I'll own starter kit. Plan: combine runbook + terraform + a 30-min "kickstart" webinar. target: pilot version in 8 business days.
Owen (Eng): I'll scope a "latency-first" routing policy we can toggle per-tenant. API sketch:
```
policy:
  name: latency_first
  prefer_variants: [quantized-low-kv, short-kv]
  fallback: regional-hosted
  max_99th_ms: 250
```
Owen (Eng): caveat: some quantized kernels need validation on customer GPU families; may add a 1-week infra validation task.
Marta (Data): I'll run prompt-sensitivity checks for the top 4 lost deals and deliver model delta tables in 5 working days.
Sam (CEO): Leadership ask: give me 3 items we can ship in <= 8 weeks, owner, and rough effort. Put blockers here.
Priya (Product): My 3: onboarding starter kit (Hannah, 2w), latency routing flag + Console toggle (Owen, 3w), Dedicated vs Hosted one-pager (Diego, 3d).
Diego (Sales): I'll have the one-pager + procurement checklist by end of week.
Hannah (Customer Success): Blocker: need a small terraform example from Eng for the starter kit (VPC peering + security group snippet). Owen?
Owen (Eng): I'll add a minimal terraform module to repo and link it. est 3 business days. Also scheduling kernel validation on Tuesday.
Priya (Product): Blocker: Legal needs to provide a DPA template for Dedicated sales. I'll ping Legal, Diego please list the legal asks you got.
Diego (Sales): Legal asks: retention terms, data residency language, subprocessor list. I'll collate into a single doc.
All-Hands Bot: logged action items into all-hands notes (link: https://redwood.example.co/all-hands/2112233344/actions) :white_check_mark:
Sam (CEO): awesome. final: keep replies tight and update status in this thread. we'll review at next cadence. thanks all. :clap:
